sloka: सुवर्णपुङ्खैर्नाराचैर्बलवन्तौ कृतव्रणौ।प्रसुस्रुवाते रुधिरं कीर्तिमन्तौ जये धृतौ ।। ६.८९.३२ ।।
transliteration: suvarṇapuṅkhairnārācairbalavantau kṛtavraṇau।prasusruvāte rudhiraṁ kīrtimantau jaye dhṛtau ।। 6.89.32 ।।

translations.english: When both of them were thus fighting, the exceedingly frightening sound that was heard was like the murmur of clouds.
